_comment: Shared fixtures for the vowelling gate mirror pair. Read by BOTH plan-dashboard/scripts/lib/vowelling.test.mjs and scripts/podcast/tests/test_vowelling.py, so a change to either implementation that is not matched in the other fails a test rather than letting the Composer's Diacritics button and the compose-time vowelling pass disagree about what may reach book.md. The gate is not about WHETHER to vowel (settled 2026-07-29: always) — it is the marks-only rule that keeps a model from moving letters under cover of marking them.

markCount._why: fatha, kasra, shadda, fatha, damma — the shadda counts

isCandidate._why: a bare passage of real length — the case the pass exists for
isCandidate.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم، هداه الله إلى ما لا يعلم

isCandidate._why: already vowelled (a Qur'anic run carries the mushaf's own marks)
too short to be a passage

isArabicPassage.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم

isArabicPassage._why: English prose quoting Arabic is not a passage to vowel
isArabicPassage.in: The Master said, quoting فإنه من عمل لله, that knowledge is given

isArabicPassage._why: one stray reference marker is tolerated
isArabicPassage.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم a

rejection.out: no Arabic script in the candidate

rejection._why: returned unchanged — no marks to show for the call
a word was dropped — letters moved, which the gate exists to catch
rejection.source: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم
